subject: Suspicious auth activity / IRP & evidence request for Greenline integration
messages:
From: security@greenlinehealth.com
To: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: legal@greenlinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspicious auth activity affecting Greenline org integration

Hi Chloe,

Monitoring picked up a spike of failed and then successful authentication attempts from an IP range that has been associated with credential stuffing. The activity appears to target the service account that Greenline uses to pull embeddings from Redwood; timestamps are concentrated between 2027-04-20 08:50 and 2027-04-20 09:05 PDT.

We wanted to notify you immediately and request the following so we can complete our initial impact assessment and, if needed, a formal report for our board/regulator:

- Confirmation whether Redwood observed any anomalous activity tied to the Greenline service account during the referenced window.
- A copy of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) or the IRP section that covers credential compromise & containment.
- Redacted access logs and auth telemetry for the service account (we only need 2027-04-20T08:30:00 to 2027-04-20T09:30:00 PDT).
- Any preliminary containment or mitigation steps you enacted (e.g., token rotation, rate limiting, geo blocks).
- SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ artifacts you can share for immediate review (redacted as needed).

We appreciate a POC and estimated ETA for the materials — Legal also asked for any evidence files to be delivered under your standard evidence transfer procedure. Please include any HMAC/signed digests for large bundles.

Thanks,
Ava Romero
Security Operations
Greenline Health
security@greenlinehealth.com

--
Attachment: none (we will accept secure transfer: s3 presign or DocuSign upload link)

From: chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
To: security@greenlinehealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious auth activity affecting Greenline org integration

Hi Ava,

Thank you for the heads up — we take this very seriously. I'm the primary POC for Greenline from our side. We've started a triage and containment workflow; current status:

- Immediate action: rotated the API key tied to the Greenline service account at 09:10 PDT and throttled calls from the suspicious IP range.
- Triage: collecting auth telemetry and access logs for the window you requested (08:30–09:30 PDT).
- Next: forensics team will produce a redacted snapshot and SHA256 digests for transferred files.

I attached our IRP checklist to speed review and to show our containment process (redacted for external consumption). We'll provide the log extract and a CAIQ/SIG artifact subset within 3 business days; if you need expedited transfer, we can push the auth snapshot first.

Requested items from you if possible:
- A signed evidence request (legal) or secure upload link.
- Any downstream indicators of compromise (user reports, syslog extracts) that help us scope impact.

I'll follow up with the S3 snapshot and the CAIQ partial matrix once Marissa and the forensics team finish redaction.

Best,

Chloe Martin
Customer Security Lead
Redwood Inference

Chloe / Ava,

Quick update from forensics: we pulled an auth snapshot (redacted) and a minimal telemetry export for 2027-04-20T08:30:00–2027-04-20T09:30:00 PDT. Highlights:

- Multiple failed attempts followed by a small number of successful token exchanges from a narrow set of IPs; geographic mapping shows most originating outside expected Greenline IP ranges.
- No downstream data exfil observed on Redwood side; calls using the rotated key after 09:10 show normal behavior.
- We have preserved raw logs and will provide HMAC digests.

Attachments attached now for immediate review (redacted as discussed):
- s3_auth_snapshot_20270420_redacted.csv  (contains timestamp, truncated IPs, auth outcome)
- caiq_partial_20270420.xlsx  (fields filled that relate to auth and key management; marked for legal redaction)

We will not provide full raw logs externally without a signed request from Greenline legal — please use the DocuSign upload link Chloe shared or provide your preferred secure upload.

I will also open a JIRA (SEC-4792) to track step-by-step actions and the deliverables.

- Marissa

Thanks for the quick loop. Short summary and next steps (internal & customer-facing):

- Containment: confirmed API key rotation at 09:10 PDT and temporary IP throttle applied.
